decisions.briefing: Stocks fell today. The NASDAQ dropped 1.2% and the S&P 500 lost 0.7%, so the market is in risk-off mode and the screener returned no buy candidates. Cash is $445.88, which is under the $500 buy threshold, so I made no trades. All 7 positions stay open, and their automatic stop-losses and profit targets remain in place.

market_education.summary_en: The NASDAQ fell 1.2% and the S&P 500 fell 0.7%, so tech and growth stocks dropped more than the broad market. When the NASDAQ falls harder than the S&P 500, investors are usually moving money out of higher-valuation growth stocks and into safer assets. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation uses only the index moves and does not name a specific cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 納斯達克指數今日下跌1.2%，標普500指數下跌0.7%，科技及增長股的跌幅明顯大於大市。納指跌幅大於標普500，通常反映資金正撤離估值較高的增長股，轉投較穩健的資產。今日數據未附新聞標題，因此以上分析只根據指數走勢，未有指明具體觸發因素。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like tech and growth stocks, putting their money somewhere safer instead. You can often spot it when the NASDAQ, which is heavy in tech, falls more than the wider market. On risk-off days, holding off on new buys helps avoid buying just as prices keep falling.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者轉趨審慎，沽售科技股、增長股等較高風險的資產，把資金轉往較安全的地方。以科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅大於大市時，往往就是避險情緒升溫的訊號。在避險氣氛濃厚的日子暫停建倉，可以避免在股價仍在下跌時過早入市。
